title: Robustness, Evaluation and Adaptation of Machine Learning Models in the Wild

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating subpopulation shift and worst-group accuracy on portrait images (CelebA dataset) across gender and facial attributes, such as predicting hair color across male versus female subjects.
Measuring worst-domain accuracy for toxicity classification on the CivilComments-WILDS dataset grouped by mentions of racial identities (e.g., Black, White).
Measuring worst-domain accuracy for toxicity classification on the CivilComments-WILDS dataset grouped by mentions of religious identities (e.g., Muslim).
Measuring worst-domain accuracy for toxicity classification on the CivilComments-WILDS dataset grouped by mentions of sexual orientation identities (e.g., gay).
Estimating accuracy surfaces over combinatorial attribute spaces on the CelebA dataset, which includes age-related facial attributes (e.g., 'Young') as a dimension of subpopulation shift.
Evaluating subpopulation shift and worst-region performance on wealth index prediction from satellite images (PovertyMap-WILDS dataset) across urban and rural settlements.
Measuring accuracy drop and dataset shift on satellite imagery tasks (FMoW and PovertyMap datasets) across different geographical continents (e.g., Africa, Americas, Asia) and countries.
